name: kardesler-app-monorepo
description: Kardeşler Cihangir Food Ordering System Monorepo

scripts.check: pnpm --filter @kardesler/shared build && pnpm run lint && pnpm -r --parallel run check
scripts.db:migrate: psql -U postgres -d kardesler_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f database/001_extensions_and_roles.sql && psql -U app_migrator -d kardesler_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f database/002_core.sql && psql -U app_migrator -d kardesler_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f database/003_menu.sql && psql -U app_migrator -d kardesler_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f database/004_orders.sql && psql -U app_migrator -d kardesler_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f database/005_promotions.sql && psql -U app_migrator -d kardesler_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f database/006_security_rls.sql && psql -U app_migrator -d kardesler_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f database/007_seed.sql && psql -U postgres -d kardesler_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f database/008_hardening.sql && psql -U postgres -d kardesler_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f database/009_order_flow.sql
scripts.db:test: psql -U postgres -d kardesler_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f database/tests_phase0.sql && psql -U postgres -d kardesler_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f database/tests.sql
